title: Palermo Stone shows pre-dynastic Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: And I believe it's the Polarmo stone that shows that there's Egyptian civilization that dates back far before the dynastic period.

plain: The Palermo Stone, an ancient Egyptian inscribed stone, is said to show that Egyptian civilization goes back long before the age of the pharaohs who ruled in dynasties. A guest named Geoffrey Drumm says this on the show, hedging that he "believes" it is the Palermo Stone that shows it. If true, Egypt's civilization would be much older than the usual history allows.
